name: Port-Menier
text: Port-Menier, Quebec (French pronunciation: [pɔʁ mənje]) is a town at the south-western end of Anticosti Island, Quebec, Canada, part of the L'Île-d'Anticosti municipality. The port village was built during the late 19th century by French chocolate maker Henri Menier. The village is the hub of Anticosti Island.
